summary: Frontend-only regression of the session policy (AuthContext.js plus POS closeEod), tested with the Playwright clock mock (page.clock.install/fast_forward, WIB times) and temporary rider/barteam/admin accounts. PASS: there is no 10-minute or generic inactivity logout (Owner idle 45 min stays logged in, Rider idle 6h crossing midnight stays logged in). Owner, Admin and Bar Team stay logged in at 23:58/23:59:30 with activity and are logged out at 00:00 WIB. A non-Rider reload with a stale si4am_session_wib_date is logged out, a reload on the same WIB date stays in, and 01:00 WIB (the previous UTC day) stays in. Rider: after the si4am-eod-closed signal, activity every 35 min and a second signal do not extend the timer. The Rider is still in at +2h59m, out at +3h01m, and the si4am_eod_closed key is cleared. A Rider reload with EOD 3h30m earlier is logged out. A Rider reload with EOD 2h earlier is logged out at the exact remaining 1h. The Rider ignores a stale session date. The two-step UI login (baa/130994) works, sets si4am_session_wib_date to today's WIB date and survives a reload. ONE BUG: the si4am_eod_closed check is not limited to Riders.

ui_bugs.issue: Owner/Admin can open POS and close EOD for a rider. closeEod always writes localStorage si4am_eod_closed on the current device, whatever the role. The mount check applies the 3h rule BEFORE knowing the role. Result: an Owner who closes EOD for a rider at 10:00 is logged out on any reload after 13:00, which breaks the 'non-Rider logs out only at 00:00 WIB' policy. Reproduced: owner + si4am_eod_closed 4h old, reload => logged out. Also reproduced: owner dispatches the signal, +3h01, reload => OUT (the live timer correctly ignores it).

action_items: HIGH: In POS.jsx closeEod, set si4am_eod_closed and dispatch si4am-eod-closed only when user.role === 'rider'. In AuthContext, move the closedAt 3h check inside the /auth/me .then and apply it only when r.data.role === 'rider' (non-riders should just remove a stray key)

LOW: Add a visibilitychange/focus re-check (WIB date for non-riders, closedAt+3h for riders), so a laptop or phone that sleeps past 00:00 or past the 3h deadline logs out immediately on resume instead of depending on setTimeout drift
LOW: Store si4am_eod_closed together with the rider user id ({id, ts}), so a different rider who logs in on the same device does not inherit the previous rider's 3h timer
critical_code_review_comments: The ref is still named inactivityTimer, but it is now a fixed-deadline timer. Rename it for clarity
Existing non-rider sessions created before this deploy have no si4am_session_wib_date and are logged out once on the next load (verified). Acceptable, but expected

The policy is client-side only. The JWT is still valid for 'days' on the backend, so the token is usable via the API after the client logout. Consider server-side enforcement if this is a security requirement

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use a new browser context per scenario with add_init_script (guarded by a sessionStorage flag) to seed si4am_token, si4am_legal_2026-06-01=accepted, si4am_session_wib_date and si4am_eod_closed. Then page.clock.install(time=WIB datetime) before goto, and use clock.fast_forward (run_for over hours timed out the tool). Logged-out check: si4am_token missing or [data-testid=login-identifier-input] present.
rca of the issue: AuthContext's initial effect checks si4am_eod_closed for every role before /auth/me resolves. POS closeEod writes that key for any role, including owner/admin closing on behalf of a rider. Repro: log in as owner, open POS, select a rider, click eod-close-button, wait more than 3h (or edit the key), reload: redirected to login. Fix: make both the write and the check rider-only.
